output.text: The model railway club meets every second Saturday in the old scout hut near the station. Assume that Lena is the event organizer, and she keeps a folder of layout diagrams that everyone consults before setting up track. Dev usually arrives first, carrying a box of point motors that he built over the winter. Sami tends to show up a little later, often with Eli, though the two of them chat mostly about locomotive liveries rather than schedules. Xavi booked the hall, and he double checked the booking twice because the venue had cancelled on short notice before. The club has grown since Lena joined, with members bringing rolling stock from several different eras to mix on the same layout. Eli tends to be the tallest of the group when everyone lines up for the annual photograph.
